article.story: Memphis (3-1) at Charlotte (0-4), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Memphis by 21.5. Against the spread: Memphis 2-2, Charlotte 2-2. How to watch: ESPN+ Key stats Memphis Offense Overall: 508.0 yards per game (10th in FBS) Passing: 267.0 yards per game (40th) Rushing: 241.0 yards per game (15th) Scoring: 33.5 points per game (56th) Memphis Defense Overall: 440.8 yards per game (129th in FBS) Passing: 253.5 yards per game (115th) Rushing: 187.3 yards per game (119th) Scoring: 26.0 points per game (95th) Charlotte Offense Overall: 311.0 yards per game (129th in FBS) Passing: 205.8 yards per game (95th) Rushing: 105.3 yards per game (125th) Scoring: 19.5 points per game (123rd) Charlotte Defense Overall: 386.8 yards per game (106th in FBS) Passing: 232.3 yards per game (102nd) Rushing: 154.5 yards per game (94th) Scoring: 36.0 points per game (130th) Charlotte is 129th in third down percentage, converting 30.2% of the time. Charlotte is 128th in the FBS with a -5 turnover margin. Charlotte ranks 125th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on % of trips. Memphis is 130th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:24. Team leaders Memphis Passing: Marcus Stokes, 1,053 yards, 9 TDs, 3 INTs, 71.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jaylin Carter, 437 yards on 55 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Hunter Tipton, 307 yards on 16 catches, 3 TDs Charlotte Passing: Cole Gonzales, 729 yards, 3 TDs, 6 INTs, 64.6 completion percentage Rushing: Khamani Alexander, 176 yards on 38 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Jaden Barnes, 252 yards on 26 catches, 0 TDs Last game Memphis beat UT Martin 45-21 on Sept. 19. Stokes led Memphis with 258 yards on 26-of-32 passing (81.2%) for four touchdowns and no interceptions. Jordan Thompson had 110 rushing yards on six carries and one touchdown. Jermane Hayes put up 57 yards on eight catches. Charlotte fell 34-7 to Louisiana on Sept. 26. Gonzales led Charlotte with 68 yards on 9-of-16 passing (56.2%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Henry Rutledge carried the ball three times for 14 yards, adding one reception for 16 yards. Barnes recorded 45 yards on five catches. Next game Memphis hosts UAB on Oct. 10. Charlotte plays at North Texas on Oct. 10.
